title: Build a No-Code AI Automation
description: Build a real, working automation that uses AI to handle a recurring task — without writing a single line of code.
tools: ChatGPT or Claude API (or Zapier AI steps)
steps: Identify a real recurring task: email triage, weekly report generation, form response handling
Map out the workflow: trigger → AI step → action
In Zapier, create a new Zap with your trigger (e.g. new email with specific label)
Add an AI step (Zapier has built-in AI actions) to summarize, classify, or transform the content
Add the output action (e.g. create Notion page, send Slack message, add to spreadsheet)
Test with 5 real examples and refine the AI prompt
expectedOutput: A live, working automation that handles a real task with zero manual effort after setup.
bonusChallenges: Add a second condition: if AI classifies as "urgent", also send a Slack alert
Measure time saved over one month
